role: fixed viewed-data joint keyframe pose experiment; not held out
inputs: depth PNG and acquisition timestamps only; RGB and numeric labels not decoded operationally
retained_references: first plus newest2 motion-selected keys plus last accepted if distinct, at most4 references
fixed_origin: first pose exactly identity; never optimized or reset
factors: every newer-to-older node pair with at least200 raw geometric matches; graph must connect every node to first
joint_variables: all non-first poses; fixed mode optimizes current pose only using identical window and factor definitions
target_jacobian: negative source left-root Jacobian [n_root, q_source_root cross n_root]
geometry: raw keyframes; no depth fusion, no external prior or synthetic measurements
failure_atomic: no pose/reference/accepted clock changes on rejection; observed timestamp may advance; expiry latches
scoring: only after all4 complete operational branches; all outcomes remain in denominators
promotion: no default replacement unless both viewed records improve over original fused-depth64/161; held-out validation still required
